name: Norellraptor
sum: Small microraptorian dromaeosaurid from the Early Cretaceous Jiufotang Formation of China, preserved as a complete skeleton with feather impressions.
wsnote: Skeleton about 57 cm long (Wikipedia revision 1386557079); the specimen was a post-juvenile.
holotype: Specimen 130108-MHGU-F4281, a complete skeleton with plumage impressions, Jiufotang Formation, China.
exceptional: Plumage impressions; the tail feathers have a rachis-dominated structure.
biology: The tail feathers are rachis-dominated; the sources describe it as living in a temperate forested environment alongside the tyrannosauroid Sinotyrannus, Psittacosaurus and many early birds and pterosaurs.
author: Wang et al. 2026

sources.text: Xuri Wang, Yannan Ji, Andrea Cau, Martin Kundrát, Yichuan Liu, Yang Wang, Qiang Ji 2026. Independent assembly of the flight apparatus in a non-avian dinosaur clade. Nature Communications. doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77804-6

dates_note: No PBDB record. Wikipedia revision 1386557079 gives Barremian–Aptian for the Jiufotang Formation; the ICS bounds of both stages are used.
